contract.title: Satellite/DRL research-design review of global pressure bracket
contract.goal: Review exact commit fcfc1e42a7780a36ab8452c1659211f3d4c19da8. Check whether the 280-satellite/14-plane global population-proxy setup, 16,988-endpoint coverage ledger, load10 duplicate pair, routing/ISL settings, non-learning phase, and claim boundaries are scientifically coherent and sufficient for the first bounded pressure classification. Distinguish a real pressure experiment from access/route/downlink failure and from a future RL comparison. Check reproducibility, seed/pair identity, and whether the package accidentally claims real traffic or global service. Identify blockers versus minor issues and produce a candidate agent-review-receipt/v2 with exact paths/fields and unknowns; do not claim VM results.
acceptance: Return a clear PASS, REQUEST_CHANGES, or BLOCKED verdict.
Candidate receipt must use agent-review-receipt/v2, role satellite_drl, exact work_id/revision, distinct reviewer identity, evidence, blocking_findings, unknowns, and required_revision.
Every finding cites an exact repository path and line or JSON field and distinguishes blocker from minor.
Explicitly state whether the package is safe to proceed to finalization/authorization and that no Pro-tier routing was used.
requiredEvidence: Exact file paths and line or JSON-field references
Observed configuration, pair identity, coverage, claim-boundary and ISL-gate facts
Candidate receipt JSON and a check that no Pro-tier routing was used
